svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.5 s, bun check 37.9 s, tsgo 83.6 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.1 GiB, tsgo 53.3 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.21 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.48 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 10.94 s, 7.49 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.25 GiB; bun check 0.31 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.82 s, 0.72 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.29 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.54 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.46 s, 1.19 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.07 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.67 s, 5.13 GiB; tsgo 12.69 s, 7.61 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.07 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.11 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.29 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.09 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.20 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.53 s, 0.24 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 0.99 s, 1.14 GiB; bun check 3.02 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.76 s, 4.36 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.17 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.47 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 6.95 s, 5.48 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.31 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.82 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 7.24 s, 4.87 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.64 s, 1.17 GiB; bun check 3.76 s, 1.02 GiB; tsgo 14.73 s, 6.17 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.62 s, 1.40 GiB; bun check 5.18 s, 0.75 GiB; tsgo 11.11 s, 6.45 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.46 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 1.01 s, 0.51 GiB; tsgo 3.10 s, 1.76 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.30 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.63 s, 0.42 GiB; tsgo 1.60 s, 1.30 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.31 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.62 s, 0.44 GiB; tsgo 1.80 s, 1.45 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.77 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.34 s, 1.16 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.33 GiB; bun check 0.50 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.23 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.31 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.84 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.99 s, 1.75 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 11:53 UTC; tsrs commit d57703ab5f075e825e986716dd5fff7c2e21acff. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
